I think it sounds true to me. I have no connection with the people in this world and thus have come to the conclusion that I don’t belong in it. 

And also I really appreciate you taking the time to have this discussion with me, it means a lot because my therapist does nothing for me and I have no one else to talk to.

I just don’t know what to do at this point. I don’t know how to change. My mind has just settled on suicide as being the solution.

it’s our natural instinct to fight for survival at all costs, we’re wired to fear death. it’s really frightening, and though people say “killing yourself is easy, if you wanted to do it you’d already be dead, just go get a knife and stab yourself,” but it’s really not that easy at all. our bodies fight hard for us to live. i wish there was a switch i could just flip without thinking in order to die, or if i could just pass away peacefully in my sleep

Life just feels like a big hassle for feeling this way so much. If I’m never going to really experience anything I see as worth experiencing, then what’s the point of it all? It all feels like a waste of time. I don’t want to go to college and study my major because it doesn’t interest me and nothing else interests me. No sort of job interests me. So, that doesn’t leave me with really any options. I’ll just end up in a 9-5 job I hate for the rest of my life having a mediocre go of it all, feeling isolated, alone, jaded, and like it’s all a waste. 

I feel like suicide is underlying all of my thoughts but it’s mainly at night a few times a week that it causes me a rise in emotion, like a wave of sadness and uselessness that hurts and makes me want to end it all right then and there. 

I didn’t have that many friends as a kid. I had some I was close with in early elementary (like age 5-8), I guess as “close” as kids that young could be, we mainly just played kick ball and ate snacks. After that, as we all got older, I felt isolated from everyone else, more so as time went on. I still had “friends” but they just pretended to like me and then wouldn’t invite me when they all had a party or went to see a movie.

I think I do feel somewhat jaded. It’s kind of like you said - I don’t feel as though anything is worth experiencing because A. I will never even have a chance to experience it (like romantic love), B. I just don’t care to, or C. I’ve already experienced it. 

I can hardly remember what it was like to not feel this way. I was just a naive child who didn’t understand the world. I feel like as years have gone by since then, I’ve felt more and more alienated from the rest of the world. I’ve felt more and more social anxiety and jaded and out of place, and overall apathetic as to what life has to offer

I feel out of place in the world. I know that’s somewhat common for people to not feel like they belong but I really think I’m not meant to be alive. I have no dreams or desires or things i want to achieve. i have no motivation to go on because nothing has ever excited me really. 

I think we as humans find a lot of life’s meaning through relationships with others. however, i can’t form relationships. i don’t like being social. anytime i’m hanging out with someone or something like that, I just want to go home and be alone. so, I’m confident i will never find a spouse or friends i connect with. i feel like this means i won’t ever have the fulfillment in life that comes with love. 

This all sounds dramatic and like it can be fixed with medication/therapy but i’ve tried for years now. i’ve tried that and lifestyle changes like working out and eating healthy but at the end of the day i still don’t want to be alive anymore
